method: Playwright inspection of every live component spec demo
defectsFoundAndFixed: Carousel demo slides collapsed because slides had no min-width or meaningful height.
Carousel demo omitted indicator and accessible region attributes.
Carousel controls and indicators lacked accessible names/semantics.
Text field demo used an unsupported nested sm-input and rendered the child at zero size.
notes: Closed popup surfaces and structural option children are not treated as broken zero-size visual hosts.
Static tests now reject unregistered custom elements inside future demo markup.
